description: As a borrower I want the yearly payment bar chart to reflect my loan and chosen start month.

elements.name: Personal loan bar chart, sliders and start month

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I open the "Personal Loan" tab
I set the sliders to amount "10L", interest rate "12" and tenure "5" years
I choose "Jan 2027" in the "Schedule showing EMI payments starting from" calendar
the displayed EMI, total interest and total payment match my own calculation
the bar chart is visible
the bar chart has one interest bar and one principal bar for each year of the schedule
the tooltip of the first bar matches the calculated schedule for the first year

name: EMI calculator - Personal Loan bar chart

description:
As a borrower I want the EMI figures and the principal/interest pie chart to be correct
  so that I can trust the calculator.

elements.name: Home loan EMI figures and pie chart - Scenario A

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I open the "Home Loan" tab
I enter loan amount "25L", interest rate "10" and tenure "10" years
the displayed EMI, total interest and total payment match my own calculation
the pie chart is visible
both pie chart sections have values greater than zero
the pie chart split matches the calculated principal and interest share

elements.name: Home loan EMI figures and pie chart - Scenario B

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I open the "Home Loan" tab
I enter loan amount "50L", interest rate "7.5" and tenure "15" years
the displayed EMI, total interest and total payment match my own calculation
the pie chart is visible
both pie chart sections have values greater than zero
the pie chart split matches the calculated principal and interest share

name: EMI calculator - Home Loan pie chart
